stations.title: The API

stations.title: Your code
stations.gap: No way to ask for less

captions: Ivo's sign-up page wants one workshop at a time, and Thursdays for under forty.
Today the API can only send every workshop, so the page has to sort it out.
You read an id from the path and two filters from the query string.
Now the page asks for Thursday under forty and gets just what fits.
One workshop by id, a shorter list by query, and a clear no for the rest.
